SELECT DATE(a.applied_at) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM applications a
INNER JOIN jobs j ON a.job_id = j.id AND j.is_delete = 0
WHERE a.is_delete = 0 AND a.applied_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
AND j.hr_id = #{hrId}
GROUP BY DATE(a.applied_at) ORDER BY DATE(a.applied_at) ASC
